title: One immunization event per DVC
description: Restates QR Code Generation, 3. Step 2 — Assemble the payload; QR Code Generation, 12.1 Scenario. QR Code Generation, 3. Step 2 — Assemble the payload: “vx is 1..1. One DVC documents one immunization event. A visit at which two vaccines are administered produces two certificates and two QR codes.”.

statements.label: One immunization event per DVC
statements.requirement: A DVCMin SHALL carry exactly one vx. The library SHALL provide a helper that turns one visit with N administered vaccines into N payloads, one per vaccine, and so N certificates.
